criteria.text: .github/workflows/pr-ci.yml runs on a PR to main, with steps: install (frozen lockfile), lint, typecheck (web + api), build web, size-limit, lhci autorun.
LHCI config uses mobile default emulation, numberOfRuns 3, and error assertions for performance >= 0.9, LCP <= 2500, TBT <= 200, CLS <= 0.05, and accessibility >= 0.95. URLs include / and /projects.
size-limit checks initial JS on / against 130 KB gzip. A violation makes the job fail.
git diff origin/main for deploy.yml and release-please.yml is empty, and the new workflow has no push trigger on main.
On the draft PR, the CI job ran and the result is reported honestly, including the numbers Lighthouse measured.
Existing lint and build still pass.
